CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Handball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   C. Practise Handball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

2. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

   D. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

9. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)

10. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)

13. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

14. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
